newsitem.title: USA: FedEX says on track for $3 EPS fiscal '97.
newsitem.headline: FedEX says on track for $3 EPS fiscal '97.

text.p: Federal Express Corp is "on track" to earn $3 per share in fiscal 1997 ended May 31, Alan B. Graf, the company's chief financial officer, said Thursday.
"If your projections (for the fiscal year) don't start with a three, you're too low," Graf told reporters in a conference call following the release of the company's fiscal third-quarter earnings.
Federal Express earned $2.69 per share in fiscal 1996.
In the 1997 fiscal third quarter ended February 28, Federal Express earned $0.54 per share, in line with analysts' projections and above the $0.24 per share earned in the year- earlier period.
The company's international segment in the 1997 fiscal third quarter posted operating income of $33.8 million on revenues of $791 million.
In the year-earlier quarter, the international segment posted an operating loss of $12.7 million on revenues of $661.1 million.
Graf expected continued strong results in the international segment.
"We think international priority is the best story Federal Express has to tell right now," he said.
